action.name: Load Header Bar
action.description: Create a reusable LOOM header region with true full-width or shrink-to-content sizing and configurable branding alignment.

admin_settings.title: Header Bar
admin_settings.description: Reusable LOOM header container presentation. Starter default: fit-content width with project branding aligned left.

action.name: Project Loader
action.description: Reusable project-first LOOM loader with animated project branding, rotating tips, module progress, and canonical runtime LOOM version attribution.

admin_settings.title: Project Loader
admin_settings.description: Project-specific Loader settings are system-owned. Global Loader behavior is configured under Admin → LOOM Settings.

action.name: Load Project Logo
action.description: Resolve the project logo, contain it safely in the Header Bar, and add an alpha-masked mouse-reactive specular shine that follows the pointer without illuminating transparent pixels.

admin_settings.title: Project Logo
admin_settings.description: Logo scale is normalized: 50% equals the old 100% size; 100% equals the old 200% maximum.

action.name: Load Logo Text
action.description: Render reusable two-line project logo text with deterministic responsive fitting that cannot feed back against the header's own changing size.

admin_settings.title: Logo Text
admin_settings.description: Edit the project wordmark. Font size directly controls rendered size; responsive fitting uses the stable containing width without self-resize feedback loops.

action.name: Project Branding
action.description: Apply reusable project branding to browser metadata and visible app chrome: project name, optional tagline, and favicon.

admin_settings.title: Project Branding
admin_settings.description: Browser title, optional tagline, and project favicon.

action.name: Green Beans Background Orb Provider
action.description: Provide Green Beans pea-pod background particles plus an occasional carrot special particle through LOOM's extensible background-energy contract.

core.ui.background-orbs.provider.label: Green Beans
core.ui.background-orbs.provider.description: Supplies bundled transparent pea-pod artwork for regular ambient particles and a carrot emoji for the occasional special particle.

admin_settings.title: Green Beans Background Provider
admin_settings.description: Green Beans project-owned ambient identity: pea-pod regular particles plus an occasional carrot special particle. LOOM core owns motion, density, timing, speed, and glow controls.

action.name: Background Orbs
action.description: Render a reusable ambient energy field with project-provided artwork, LOOM electric circuitry particles, and occasional extensible special particles.

admin_settings.title: Background Energy Field
admin_settings.description: Ambient project background. Project artwork wins when a provider exists; LOOM defaults render small electric circuitry particles instead of bubbles. Occasional special particles can be overridden per project.

action.name: Footer Bar
action.description: Create a polished responsive LOOM footer with project branding, centered quick-access tools, animated LOOM attribution, and guarded fit-content spacing controls.

admin_settings.title: Footer Bar
admin_settings.description: Control the responsive footer and each independent row. The default project-branding row is centered and fit-to-content with 100px total extra width and 20px total extra height.

fields.label: Fit-content extra width
fields.help: Total extra horizontal room around project branding. LOOM divides this evenly between left and right.

fields.label: Fit-content extra height
fields.help: Total extra vertical room around project branding. LOOM divides this evenly between top and bottom.

action.name: Orb Dock
action.description: Capture eligible project modules into a responsive, content-sized footer quick-access orb dock with centered section labeling.

admin_settings.title: Orb Dock
admin_settings.description: Turn content modules into footer quick-access orbs. Project Update Log is captured by default when installed; other content modules may be orb-wrapped here.

action.name: Green Beans Avatar Extension
action.description: Provide the Green Beans project default profile picture and avatar creator using supplied String Bean / Bean Pod artwork, optional Ball Cap headwear, a selectable background color, and trait preview icons.

user_actions.name: Create Green Beans Avatar
user_actions.description: Create and apply a Green Beans profile avatar by choosing Bean Type, Headwear, and Background Color.

core.user.profile.avatar.label: Green Beans
core.user.profile.avatar.description: Overrides the automatic LOOM default with the supplied Green Beans default avatar and provides a Green Beans creator with Bean Type, Headwear, and Background Color traits. Trait previews can use dedicated icons.

admin_settings.title: Green Beans Avatar Extension
admin_settings.description: Project-provided default avatar and creator artwork are owned by the Green Beans project module. Creator traits currently include Bean Type, Headwear, and Background Color, with dedicated preview icons.

action.name: User Profile
action.description: Show project identity controls, the reusable LOOM account/global profile, privilege, network metadata, analytics, and history.

user_actions.name: Save Username
user_actions.description: Persist a display username against this LOOM client identity.

user_actions.name: Refresh Profile Analytics
user_actions.description: Refresh lifetime usage and session analytics.

user_actions.name: Create Permanent Account
user_actions.description: Attach email/password login to a named LOOM identity.

user_actions.name: Sign In
user_actions.description: Sign in to a permanent LOOM account.

user_actions.name: Sign Out
user_actions.description: End the current permanent account login.

user_actions.name: Upload Profile Picture
user_actions.description: Compress and persist a custom LOOM profile picture.

user_actions.name: Use LOOM Default Avatar
user_actions.description: Switch the profile picture back to the native LOOM default.

user_actions.name: Use Project Default Avatar
user_actions.description: Use the active project avatar provider default when available.

user_actions.name: Create Project Avatar
user_actions.description: Create an avatar through a project-provided avatar creator.

user_actions.name: Use LOOM Profile Picture
user_actions.description: Make this project inherit the LOOM-wide profile picture.

user_actions.name: Copy Project Picture to LOOM Profile
user_actions.description: Retrieve an existing project profile picture and use it as the global LOOM profile picture.

permissions.story: Change my own LOOM profile and avatar.

action.name: Profile Dock
action.description: Capture the reusable User Profile module out of normal project flow and expose it from the built-in LOOM project top bar.

user_actions.name: Open User Profile
user_actions.description: Open the captured User Profile from the LOOM project shell.

admin_settings.title: Profile Dock
admin_settings.description: Moves the User Profile module into the built-in project top bar.

action.name: Shopping List
action.description: Persistent Green Beans shopping list with rapid ingredient entry, manual groups, and first-class Meal Creator integration.

green-beans.shopping-list.label: Shopping List Ingredient Store
green-beans.shopping-list.description: Exposes shopping ingredients and meal-group synchronization to compatible Green Beans modules.

admin_settings.title: Shopping List
admin_settings.description: Project feature state is user-owned. Meal groups are managed by Meal Creator when that project module is present.

action.name: Meal Creator
action.description: Create named meals from Green Beans Shopping List ingredients, auto-add missing ingredients, and keep Shopping List meal groups synchronized.

green-beans.meal-creator.label: Meal Creator
green-beans.meal-creator.description: Allows compatible Green Beans modules to open meal creation/editing and synchronize ingredient relationships.

admin_settings.title: Meal Creator
admin_settings.description: Green Beans project-owned meal composition. Meal and ingredient state belongs to the current project user; no administrator content controls.

action.name: Project Update Log
action.description: Optional project-owned release history sourced only from the current project CHANGELOG.md. LOOM platform history remains on LOOM Home.

admin_settings.title: Project Update Log
admin_settings.description: Project-owned release history. This is intentionally separate from the LOOM platform update log on LOOM Home.
